Q

QuoteBoomerang

Quote sent? Boomerang follows up for you. Automatic quote follow-ups for freelancers and any business that sends quotes

Most quotes don’t get rejected. They get ignored. QuoteBoomerang makes sure that doesn’t cost you the job. After you send a quote, it follows up with the customer automatically, with a friendly reminder at the right time. You don’t have to remember, and you don’t have to chase. It’s made for anyone who sends quotes: freelancers, agencies, consultants, craftspeople and small businesses in any industry. Fewer quotes lost to silence No more manual chasing More time for the actual work Now in beta. Join the first testers and help shape it.
